senses.gloss: --the son of शुचि; also known as Dharma- सारथि. Father of शान्तरय. भा. IX. १७. ११-12.

--a Mt. near Kakudman the collyrium of which is fit for पितृस् and श्राद्ध; in it are a burning pit जात वेदस्शिला as also a तीर्थ, where the seven seers had bathed and a temple with a Nandi invisible to the unrighteous; besides golden यूपस्. Br. III. ११. ६७; १३. ५८; M. १२१. १५; वा. ४७. १३; ७७. ५७-64. [page२-042+ २६]

--(त्रिकर्णक ?) a commander of भण्ड to aid विषङ्ग;
1: Br. IV. २५. २९.
was killed by ज्वाला ma1linika1.
2: Ib. IV. २५. ९८.
--a name of शिव. वा. ३०. २१७.
--the whole universe is said to be pervaded by the three daughters of हिमवान्, अपर्णा, Eka- पर्णा and एकपाटला, all eternal youths and ब्रह्मवादिनीस्. Br. III. १०. १४; वा. ७२. १३-5.

(I)--a mountain on the base of the Meru, in भारतवर्ष;
1: भा. V. १६. २६; १९. १६.
surrounded by क्षीरोद, and १०००० yojanas high with three shining crests of silver, iron and gold; served by Siddhas, चारणस् and others. In its valley was ऋतुमत्, the pleasure garden of goddesses, full of varied trees.
2: Ib. VIII. 2. 1-१९.
(II)--Here is लन्का in मलयद्वीप. वा. ४८. २६.
--one of the ten पीठस् for images, in the shape of a trident. M. २६२. 7, १२, १८.
--see Trigartas (s.v.) [page२-043+ २७]

--their king was सुशर्म (s.v.). He was not able to vanquish Arjuna, supported by कृष्ण. He was stationed by जरासन्ध at the Northern gate of मथुरा, as also during the siege of Gomanta.
1: भा. I. १५. १६; X. ५०. ११ [7]; ५२. ११. [१४]; [५० (V) 3].
A hill tribe;
2: Br. II. १६. ६८; १८. ५३.
a hilly country.
3: वा. ४५. १३६; M. ११४. ५६.
--a mountain kingdom of Trigartas visited by बलराम. भा. X. ७९. १९.
--a son of सुतीर्थ. वा. ९९. २७४.
--a Mind-born mother. M. १७९. १७.
(त्रिणाचिकेत-वा। प्।) the Brahmanas of the Yajur Veda, fit for श्राद्ध feeding. Vi. III. १५. 2; वा 79. ५८; ८३. ५३.
--a तीर्थ visited by बलराम. भा. X. ७८. १९.
(I)--a sage who called on the dying भीष्म; was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर; came to Syamanta- पञ्चक to see कृष्ण. भा. I. 9. 7; X. ७४. 7; ८४. 5.
(II)--a son of चाक्षुष Manu. A place sacred to him on the सरस्वती; a मन्त्रकृत्. भा. IV. १३. १६; III. 1. २२; M. १४५. १०१. [page२-044+ २६]
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९४. ११.
(I)--a R. from the हिमालयस्. Br. II. १६. २६.
(II)--a R. from the ऋक्ष. Br. II. १६. ३१.
(III)--a R. in the प्लक्षद्वीप. Br. II. १९. १९; Vi. II. 4. ११.
(IV)--(शिवेतिका) a R. of the भारतवर्ष rising from the Mahendra mountain. वा. ४५. १०१, १०६.
(V)--a R. of the शाकद्वीपम्. वा. ४९. ९३.
--a R. from the Mahendra mountain. M. ११४. ३१.
--a R. from the Mahendra mountain. Br. II. १६. ३७.
(I)--a son of सम्भूति. M. १२. ३६.
(II)--the son of Vasumata, a righteous king. वा. ८८. ७७.
(III)--the son of सुमना and father of त्रय्यारुणि. Vi. IV. 3. २०.
(IV)--a son of Sumati. Br. III. ६३. ७६.

--the name of व्यास in the tenth द्वापर; भृगु, the अवतर् of the Lord;
1: Br. II. ३५. ११९; वा. २३. १४७; Vi. III. 3. १३.
heard the ब्र्। and वायु पुराणस् from सारस्वत and narrated the former to शरद्- वान्.
2: Br. IV. 4. ६१; वा. १०३. ६१.
--a son of खश, and a राक्षस. Br. III. 7. १३५.
(II)--the son of निर्वृति; ruled for २८ years. M. २७१. २७.
--the name of a horse of the Moon's chariot. M. १२६. ५२. [page२-046+ ३८]
--a mark on the forehead. Br. IV. ३८. २२.

(I)--a city built by माया, of gold, silver and iron fortifications for the sake of Asuras.
1: भा. IV. १७. १३; V. २४. २८; VII. १०. ५४ and ६८. VIII. 6. ३१; XI. १६. २०; Br. III. ७२. ८२. वा. ९७. ८२.
Really three towns under तारक, Maya and विद्युन्मालि; city described. Battle of Tripuram; march of शिव's army. First battle at तारकाख्यपुरम्; non-combatants visiting it; fight be- tween Nandi and विद्युन्मालि; तारक's fight with the गणस्; actual battle on the shores of the western sea, described; battle in the air and under water; तारक slain by Nandi, as also विद्युन्मालि; burning the city including women and children by शिव.
2: M. Chh. १२९-130; Chh. १३५-140; १८७. 8, १४-6; १८८. 9-१०.
(II)--an Asura having his city in the third Talam. Br. II. २०. २७; III. ३८. 4.
--a name of ललिता; worship of. Br. IV. 5. ३१.
--the second charioteer of ललिता. Br. IV. २०. ९१. [page२-047+ २८]
--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ४३.
--(Tripuradhvamsa): see शिव. Br. III. २३. ३२; २५. १३.
--a mother Goddess, see ललिता. Br. IV. 7. ७२; ११. 1.
--an epithet of Rudra; शिव with १६ hands danced in joy at the ruin of the city, Tripuram (s.v.). M. १७९. ३८; २५९. ११.
--a Guptayogini. Br. IV. ३६. ७२.

--deals with the construction of Tri- pura by Maya; trouble to the world by the Asuras; Gods wait on Rudra; the war chariot of शिव; नारद's mediation; Maya gets ready for war; the war; the efforts of गणस्, especially Nandi's part in the battle; death of तारक; the second day of the battle; शिव's victory by burning the city. M. Chh. १२९-141.

(I)--near the दृषद्वती;
1: Br. III. १३. ६९.
like श्यामक and इक्षु being created by Gods;
2: Ib. १४. 8.
to be propitiated at the Parva and at the Tithis.
3: Ib. १७. 6.
[page२-048+ २४]
--the son of अरुण and father of Satya- vrata. भा. IX. 7. 4-5.
--a R. from the Mahendra hills. M. ११४. ३१.
--the son of भानुमत्, and father of Karam- dhama. भा. IX. २३. १७.
--the Brahmanas of the साम Veda fit for feeding on the श्राद्ध occasions. Vi. III. १५. 2.
--a horse of the Moon's chariot. वा. ५२. ५३.
--is Om; प्रणव constituted by वैद्युती, तामसी and निर्गुणि Ma1tras. वा. २०. 1.
--a Pravara. M. १९६. ३०.
--(नियामिका) night, so called. Br. II. 8. 6, २३.
--progress of, depends on the sun without which there would be no reckoning of time and nothing would go on. वा. ५०. ६०; ५३. ३४-41. [page२-049+ ३७]
(I)--शिव known in Trayambaka क्षेत्र; meditation of. M. २२. ४७; १३१. ३५; २६६. ३६; Vi. V. ३३. 1.
(II)--a name of विघ्नेश्वर. Br. IV. ४४. ६७.

--a hunchback maid who supplied unguents to Kamsa. For the mere asking she gave them away to कृष्ण and his brother. Pleased at this, कृष्ण converted her into a beautiful maid. She requested him to go to her house and honour her with his company. He promised to do so after his other engagements were over.
1: भा. X. ४२. 1-१२.
Visited by कृष्ण with Uddhava. Her house was found filled with pictures drawn according to the कामशास्त्र. After spend- ing some time there, कृष्ण left.
2: Ib. X. ४८. 1-१०.
Her son was विशोक.
3: Ib. X. ९०. ३४[1].
Came to see कृष्ण and सत्यभामा returning from Indra's abode.
4: Ib. X. [६७ (V) ५०].
--(Cyavana?) son of अन्तिनार. M. ४९. 8.

--three ends of human endeavour, Dharma, Artha and काम; was taught to प्रह्लाद by his tutors. This did not appeal to him. It should be a means to realise Hari, according to प्रह्लाद.
1: भा. VII. 5. ५२-53; 6. २६.
Even the householder, it is said, should not exert himself too much for Trivarga. But it is generally observed by householders.
2: Ib. VII. १४. १०; VIII. १६. ११. Vi. III. ११. 6.
A भिक्षु is expected to discard it.
3: भा. VII. १५. ३६; Br. III. ५०. ५२; ५१. १५.
To one devoid of Dharma, the other two, काम and Artha, are of one use.
4: M. २९. 3; ५३. 4, ४५; २१२. 3-9.
[page२-050+ २९]
--the eleventh Veda-व्यास. Br. II. ३५. ११९.
--a group of mountains round मेरुमूल. वा. ३५. 7.
--heard the ब्रह्माण्ड and वायु पुरणस् from शरद्वान् (शरद्वत) and narrated the former to अन्तरिक्ष. Br. IV. 4. ६१; वा. १०३. ६१.

--a साम;
1: वा. 9. ४८.
created from ब्रह्मा's face.
2: Br. II. 8. ५०.
--from the first face of ब्रह्मा. Vi. I. 5. ५३.

--Satyavrata (s.v): the son of Tribandhana and father of हरिश्चन्द्र; became a चण्डाल by the curse of his Guru; three spikes meant for him by वसिष्ठ. Result of his three sins--displeasing his father, killing the Guru's cow and eating unconsecrated flesh; banished from the kingdom; seeing this विश्वामित्र consoled him and agreed to be his Guru; the latter had him crowned after a purifica- tion bath in the river, कर्मनाशा near the Vindhyas; this enabled him to go to heaven bodily and get a place among [page२-051+ ३१] the planets all in the presence of वसिष्ठ; though thrust down headlong from heaven, he was stopped and given a place in the sky. भा. IX. 7. 5-7; Br. III. ६३. १०८; वा. ८८. १०८-13. Vi. IV. 3. २१.
--the planet त्रिशङ्कु or Satyavrata in the moon's sphere, Cf. रामा. Yud., IV. ९०. वा. ८८. ११५-6.
--the territory north of the महा- नदी and south of वैकट (कैकट-वा। प्।) unfit for श्राद्ध. Br. III. १४. ३१-2; M. १६. १६; वा. ७८. २१. 2.
--also known as धान्यकम्. M. २५३. ५१; २५४. 4-7.
(I)--was Indra of the तामस epoch. भा. VIII. 1. २८.
(II)--the Veda-व्यास of the eleventh द्वापर, see त्रिवर्ष. Vi. III. 3. १४.
--a Mt. sacred to शिव. M. १८३. 2.

(I)--a son of त्वष्ट and यशोधरा;
1: Br. III. 1. ८६; वा. ६५. ८५.
his mother was a sister of Virocana;
2: वा. ८४. १९.
a राक्षस killed by राम.
3: भा. IX. १०. 9; वा. ६९. १६७.
His city was in the third Talam.
4: Br. II. २०. २६; वा. ५०. २६.
[page२-052+ ३०]
(II)--a son of खश and a राक्षस. Br. III. 7. १३५.
(III)--a son of विश्रवस् and वाका. Br. III. 8. ५६; वा. ७०. ५०.
(IV)--a son of प्रह्रादि and त्वष्टा ?. Br. III. ५९. १९-20.

--the trident of शिव;
1: Br. III. ३२. १४; IV. १९. 6, ८५; २०. ८१; वा. १०१. २७१.
made from the वैष्- णव तेजस् of the sun filed off by त्वष्ट.
2: M. 5. ३१; ११. २९; २१७. ३१ Vi. III. 2. ११.

--a Mt. on the north of Meru;
1: भा. V. १६. २७; M. १६३. ८६; Vi. II. 2. ४४.
west of the शितोद.
2: वा. ३६. २९; ४२. ७२.
--one who performs the three ablutions, at dawn, noon and sunset; fit for performing श्राद्ध. वा. ७४. १२.

--a poetic metre;
1: भा. III. १२. ४५; XI. २१. ४१; M. १२५. ४७.
a Chandas serving as a horse in the Sun's chariot,
2: Br. II. २२. ७२; वा. ५१. ६४; Vi. II. 8. 5.
with गायत्रि and Jagati forms the Tri- वर्णम् or प्रणव.
3: Br. II. १३. १४५; वा. ३१. ४७.
(I)--The goddess enshrined at गोदाश्रम. M. १३. ३७.
(II)--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ४६. [page२-053+ ३१]
--the son of गोभानु, and father of Karan- dhama. Br. III. ७४. 1; वा. ९९. 1.
--a R. in भारतवर्ष, from the Mahendra hill. भा. V. १९. १८; Br. II. १६. ३७; वा. ४५. १०६; Vi. II. 3. १३.
--a son of गोभानु. M. ४८. 1.

--the Brahmanas versed in सुपर्ण sec- tions;
1: वा. ८३. ५३.
eligible for पार्वण S4ra1ddha.
2: M. १६. 7; Vi. III. १५. 2.
--of the lord--Divya, आन्तरिक्ष and Bhauma. वा. २३. १०४, १०७.
